model: DeepJSCC-Q encoder (JSAIT 2022 architecture, jointly fine-tuned) + shallow decoder (linear 3x3, 4 PWL residual blocks, 2 sub-pixel upsamplings), C=32, Cout=16, 64-QAM

engines.name: sd.conv1_plus_res
engines.note: upsampling main and skip 3x3 merged (same input)

format.mem: one value per line, two's complement hex, digits = ceil(bits/4)
format.channel: AWGN 10.0 dB on the unit-power 64-QAM symbols, seed 20260928; rx_symbols = receiver output Q10 (12 bit) per symbol [I,Q]
format.latent_pairing: as data/model (NHWC stream order, channels (2j, 2j+1) = (I, Q))

arithmetic.pwl: s = clamp(((x - T0) >>> STEP_LOG2) + 1, 0, NK); k = max(s - 1, 0); acc = yk[c][k] + slope[c][s] * (x - (T0 + (k << STEP_LOG2))); y = satA(rsr(sat27(rsr(acc, pre[c])) * M[c], sh[c]))

ops.pairing: NHWC stream order: symbol = channels (2j, 2j+1) of one pixel = (I, Q)
